an10.41:1.1: [sāvatthi] atha kho āyasmā upāli yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā upāli bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
an10.41:1.2: “ko nu kho bhante hetu, ko paccayo yena saṅghe bhaṇḍanakalahaviggahavivādā uppajjanti bhikkhu ca na phāsu viharantī”ti?
an10.41:1.3: idhūpāli bhikkhu adhammaṃ dhammoti dīpenti, dhammaṃ adhammoti dīpenti, avinayaṃ vinayoti dīpenti, vinayaṃ avinayoti dīpenti, abhāsitaṃ alapitaṃ tathāgatena bhāsitaṃ lapitaṃ tathāgatenāti dīpenti, bhāsitaṃ lapitaṃ tathāgatena abhāsitaṃ alapitaṃ tathāgatenāti dīpenti, anāciṇṇaṃ tathāgatena āciṇṇaṃ tathāgatenāti dīpenti, āciṇṇaṃ tathāgatena anāciṇṇaṃ tathāgatenāti dīpenti, apaññattaṃ tathāgatena paññattaṃ tathāgatenāti dīpenti, paññattaṃ tathāgatena apaññattaṃ tathāgatenāti dīpenti.
an10.41:1.4: ayaṃ kho upāli hetu ayaṃ paccayo yena saṅghe bhaṇḍana kalaha viggaha vivādā uppajjanti, bhikkhu ca na phāsu viharantī
